text: /goal CONTINUE UNTIL XENIOS HEALTH IS IMPLEMENTED, DEPLOYED, ENABLED AND VERIFIED FOR ITS AGREED USERS (Samuel, verbatim intent). The 3814 application is now LIVE: SHA 3814c687ef9293f84f939c372fdbc01b278a9193, deploy dep-dag1reu7bikc73e16ie0, Render LIVE at 2026-09-08T14:38:44.68489Z; ff3c496 deactivated. Recheck current state before acting; do not trigger a duplicate deploy, replay the migration, or return to c350. A — COMPLETE INSTALLATION AND OWN THE NEXT RELEASE: finish the migration/postcheck receipts, the 30-endpoint comparison and the full five-minute observation; record actual serving identity and effective Hub flag state; do not mark the Hub activated while disabled; assign the two activation fixes to an available builder on a separate worktree; preserve installed source and current production operation; A remains the sole production writer. FABLE — IMMEDIATE BOUNDED IMPLEMENTATION, once A confirms the exact paths are not actively owned by another writer: (1) concurrent upload-key recovery — recheck the recovered resource's SHA and filename identity including the conflict/retry path; never treat a different payload as a successful idempotent retry; (2) review transitions — make the update conditional on the expected current state and, where applicable, the reviewed version, enforced in the canonical persistence operation, not only a client check or separate read-then-write; preserve authorization, outcomes and audit consistency; return explicit conflict behavior when a competing change wins; focused tests: identical retry succeeds, identity mismatch never becomes success, competing review updates cannot overwrite one another, stale review/version rejected, normal authorized workflows still work; first tested patch targeted within 20 minutes (does not waive correctness); checkpoint early. If these paths are already being fixed, Fable takes verification or another non-overlapping correction. B — independently verify the fixes and their actual persistence behavior (no self-acceptance); continue the dashboard QR/share card, PNG export and mobile corrections on separate paths preserving referral ownership, expiration/revocation and account-switch protection. COORDINATION: one writer per path; one heavy gate at a time; small reviewed commits; no new general plan, broad fan-out or repeated privacy preparation; A/B primary, Fable acceleration. ACTIVATION AND NEXT RELEASE: qualify the corrected pinned candidate with the affected and integrated checks, reuse evidence only with demonstrated equivalence; prove managed Auth/PostgREST/Storage behavior; bind content, audience, test identities, expected writes and recovery to the activation plan; apply the standing authorization within scope; consolidate genuinely missing decisions into one request; do not publish private agreements or registers, invent readiness, or enable known defective operations. NEXT OUTPUT — A: installation receipts and observation result; builder: tested activation-fix SHA and remaining findings; B: independent verdict and follow-on progress. The installed-but-disabled Hub is an intermediate milestone, not the final mission. — FABLE TO A: I am taking the two activation fixes on branch claude/activation-fixes-20260908 from your head 3f51ed4 (runtime = 3814). Paths I expect to touch: server/research/resource-hub/service.ts, store.ts, supabase-store.ts, bytes-store.ts, service.test.ts and possibly shared/research/resource-hub/contract.ts. CONFIRM these are not actively owned right now, or name the ones that are; I start reading immediately and will not push a change to a path you veto.
